player_prompt.intro:
Ou se {role} nan Kolonèl Blotto.
Bòd ou se genyen plis rond pase advè ou.
Sou chak rond, ou dwe aloke eksakteman {num_total_units} inite atravè chan {field_names}.
Jwè a ki aloke plis inite nan yon chan genyen chan an, epi jwè a ki genyen plis chan genyen rond la.
Pa egzanp, '[A7 B7 C6]' aloke 7 inite nan A, 7 nan B, ak 6 nan C.

game_state.header_round:
=== Kolonèl Blotto - Rond {current_round}/{num_rounds} ===
Rond genyen - Komandan Alpha: {alpha_score}, Komandan Beta: {beta_score}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Format opinyon ki pa valab. Sèvi ak: A: 5, B:10, C:5
invalid_move.invalid_field: Non jaden ki pa valab (s). Chanp valab: {field_names}
invalid_move.wrong_allocation_value: Tout alokasyon yo dwe non-negatif antye.
invalid_move.incorrect_total_units: Ou dwe aloke eksakteman {num_total_units} inite. Som en kouwènt: {current_sum}

outcome.draw: Jwè a fini an {score_0}-{score_1} egalite apre {num_rounds} rond!
